text: dsh-visual-card 是供 DSH Web 客户端使用的可视化插件，通过 render_visual 工具接收标题、HTML 片段和可选高度，并把卡片显示在本轮回答下方。卡片内容放在 iframe 中，可用于展示图表、色板、布局示意和交互演示；工具栏支持全屏、复制 HTML 和下载 HTML，主题颜色会映射到卡片。插件按会话与轮次保存卡片，并提供高度上限、脚本开关、历史保留数量等设置。适合希望在对话中呈现可操作图形或小型演示的用户；代码未发现需要 API key 或外部服务。

dsh-visual-card adds interactive HTML cards below DSH web responses. Use render_visual to provide a title and HTML; cards support fullscreen, copy, download, and theme colors. They are stored by conversation and turn, with display and retention settings. No API key or external service is required.
想让 DSH 在回答下面显示可以点击操作的 HTML 演示。
能不能把对话里生成的图表放大到全屏，之后还能下载？
I want a visual answer with interactive controls rendered beneath the chat response.
dsh-visual-card 的功能「交互式可视化卡片」：调用 render_visual 并提供标题与 HTML 片段，即可在本轮回答下方显示卡片；可选指定高度，卡片工具栏提供全屏、复制和下载 HTML 操作。
dsh-visual-card 的功能「会话卡片与外观设置」：插件按会话和轮次保存可视化内容，并在设置页调整卡片高度上限、脚本开关、保留轮数和每轮数量。
dsh-visual-card README · dsh-visual-card： **中文** | [English](#english) 可视化回答插件：AI 交一段 HTML，在对话里渲染成一个**可交互的窗口**——能点、能用键盘操作、能全屏、能导出。

dsh-visual-card README · 效果：工具调用后，本轮回答下方出现一个窗口：

- 顶部工具条：标题 + 全屏 / 复制 / 下载
- 内容区是 AI 写的 HTML，脚本会真正执行（按钮、canvas、动画都能跑）
- 颜色自动跟随当前亮/暗主题

dsh-visual-card README · 能做什么：- 图表、色板、布局示意
- 可点击的演示（切换状态、翻页、展开细节）
- **完整的小游戏**（WASD 移动、canvas 逐帧动画）
- 需要键盘操作时，点进窗口才接管键盘，窗口外按键照常进输入框

dsh-visual-card README · 键盘规则：| 操作 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 点进窗口 | 窗口接管键盘，标题栏提示「键盘已交给窗口」 |
| 按 Esc | 释放键盘，回到输入框 |
| 点窗口外 | 自动释放 |
| 鼠标 | 始终正常（悬停、滚动、点击都不用先聚焦） |

实现上用了 iframe：AI 生成的脚本通常监听 `document` 的键盘事件，如果和宿主共用同一个文档，窗口外按键也会触发它。iframe 有独立的事件作用域，焦点不在里面就收不到键。

dsh-visual-card README · 工具：```js render_visual({ title: '标题', html: '
...
', // height 可选：不给就按内容自动定高（推荐） **高度是自动的**：宽度固定后，内容多高卡片就多高，不套固定框。内容超过设置的比例上限时，改为卡片内部滚动 —— 再大的卡片也不会逼你滚动整个对话才能看全貌。 写 HTML 时用主题变量，不要写死颜色： `--v-bg-base`、`--v-bg-layer-1/2`、`--v-border`、`--v-text`、`--v-text-dim`、`--v-brand`、`--v-success/warn/error`

dsh-visual-card README · 设置：设置 → 可视化：

| 项 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| **高度上限** | 卡片高度按内容自动决定；超过这个比例（40–100% 视口高）就改成卡片内部滚动，不逼你滚动整个对话才能看全貌 |
| **允许执行脚本** | 关掉后按钮、动画、小游戏都不运行，只显示静态内容。脚本运行在宿主页面里，这是唯一的安全风险来源 |
| **每个会话保留轮数** | 超出的旧轮次在写入时丢弃（10–2000） |
| **每轮最多卡片数** | 一轮里超过这个数量只留最新的（1–50） |
| **清空历史** | 清掉 `cards.json`，带二次确认 |

改动即时保存到 `~/.dsh/visual/settings.json`。

dsh-visual-card README · 存储：卡片按「会话 + 轮次」落盘到 `~/.dsh/visual/cards.json`，重启后仍在。保留轮数与每轮上限由设置决定。

删掉这个目录只会丢失历史可视化，不影响功能。

dsh-visual-card README · 安装：**推荐：内置插件安装程序。** 打开「设置 → 内置插件」，粘贴包名，点安装，再重启应用：

```
dsh-visual-card
```

安装程序会自动写进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，不用手改任何文件。

命令行方式（先完全退出应用）：

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm add dsh-visual-card
```

然后把包名加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，重启应用。

dsh-visual-card README · 安全说明：AI 生成的脚本**运行在宿主页面里**，不是沙箱。这是「能点击、能跑小游戏」的必然代价。

插件只约束「不引用外部资源」，不做代码审查。自己用没问题；如果要在不信任 AI 输出的场景里用，请先自行加沙箱。

dsh-visual-card README · 已知限制：- 卡片固定渲染在本轮回答**下方**，不能插入正文中间——宿主的对话节点是固定 19 种，插件无法新增节点类型 - `turnTail` 槽位只在本轮结束后渲染，所以流式输出期间看不到卡片 --- **English** | [中文](#chinese) Visual answers for DeepSeek Harness: the model hands over a block of HTML and it renders as an **interactive window** inside the conversation — clickable, keyboard-operable, fullscreen-capable, exportable.

dsh-visual-card README · What it looks like：After the tool call, a window appears below the turn's answer:

- Toolbar: title plus Fullscreen / Copy / Download
- The content area is the model's HTML, and its scripts really run (buttons, canvas, animation all work)
- Colors follow the active light/dark theme automatically

dsh-visual-card README · What you can build：- Charts, color swatches, layout sketches
- Clickable demos (state toggles, paging, expanding detail)
- **Complete small games** (WASD movement, per-frame canvas animation)
- When a demo needs the keyboard, clicking into the window takes it over; keys outside keep going to the composer

dsh-visual-card README · Keyboard rules：| Action | Behavior |
|---|---|
| Click into the window | The window takes the keyboard; the title bar says so |
| Press Esc | Release the keyboard, back to the composer |
| Click outside | Released automatically |
| Mouse | Always works — hover, scroll and click need no focus first |

dsh-visual-card README · Keyboard rules：The implementation uses an iframe. Scripts generated by the model typically listen for `keydown` on `document`; if they shared the host document, keys pressed anywhere would reach them. An iframe has its own event scope, so it only receives keys while focus is inside.

dsh-visual-card README · Tool：```js render_visual({ title: 'Title', html: '
...
', // height is optional; omit it and the card sizes itself to its content (recommended) **Height is automatic**: once the width is fixed, the card is as tall as its content — no fixed frame. When the content exceeds the configured cap, the card scrolls internally, so even a large card never forces you to scroll the whole conversation. Use theme variables instead of hard-coded colors:
dsh-visual-card README · Tool：`--v-bg-base`, `--v-bg-layer-1/2`, `--v-border`, `--v-text`, `--v-text-dim`, `--v-brand`, `--v-success/warn/error`

dsh-visual-card README · Settings：| Item | Effect |
|---|---|
| **Height cap** | Card height follows its content; above this share of the viewport (40–100%) the card scrolls internally instead of forcing a page scroll |
| **Allow scripts** | When off, buttons, animation and games do not run — only static content renders. Scripts run inside the host page, which is the only source of risk here |
| **Turns kept per conversation** | Older turns are dropped on write (10–2000) |
| **Max cards per turn** | Beyond this many in one turn only the newest are kept (1–50) |
| **Clear history** | Deletes `cards.json`, behind a second confirmation |
dsh-visual-card README · Settings：Changes save immediately to `~/.dsh/visual/settings.json`.

dsh-visual-card README · Storage：Cards are persisted per conversation and turn to `~/.dsh/visual/cards.json`, so they survive a restart. Retention is governed by the settings above.

Deleting the directory only loses visual history; functionality is unaffected.

dsh-visual-card README · Install：**The built-in plugin installer is the recommended way.** Open Settings → Built-in Plugins, paste the package name, press install, then restart the app:

```
dsh-visual-card
```

The installer writes the entry into `dsh.profile.bundles` for you; no manual file edits.

From the command line (quit the app completely first):

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm add dsh-visual-card
```

Add the package name to `dsh.profile.bundles` and restart the app.

dsh-visual-card README · Security：Scripts generated by the model **run inside the host page** — this is not a sandbox. That is the unavoidable cost of "clickable, can run games".

The plugin only enforces "no external resources" and performs no code review. Fine for personal use; if you point it at model output you do not trust, add a sandbox first.

dsh-visual-card README · Known limits：- Cards always render **below** the turn's answer and cannot be placed mid-text: the host supports a fixed set of 19 conversation node kinds, and a plugin cannot add one
- The `turnTail` slot only renders after the turn closes, so nothing appears while the answer is still streaming

dsh-visual-card README · What it looks like：After the tool call, a window appears below the turn's answer:

- Toolbar: title plus Fullscreen / Copy / Download
- The content area is the model's HTML, and its scripts really run (buttons, canvas, animation all work)
- Colors follow the active light/dark theme automatically

dsh-visual-card README · What you can build：- Charts, color swatches, layout sketches
- Clickable demos (state toggles, paging, expanding detail)
- **Complete small games** (WASD movement, per-frame canvas animation)
- When a demo needs the keyboard, clicking into the window takes it over; keys outside keep going to the composer

dsh-visual-card README · Keyboard rules：| Action | Behavior |
|---|---|
| Click into the window | The window takes the keyboard; the title bar says so |
| Press Esc | Release the keyboard, back to the composer |
| Click outside | Released automatically |
| Mouse | Always works — hover, scroll and click need no focus first |

dsh-visual-card README · Keyboard rules：The implementation uses an iframe. Scripts generated by the model typically listen for `keydown` on `document`; if they shared the host document, keys pressed anywhere would reach them. An iframe has its own event scope, so it only receives keys while focus is inside.

dsh-visual-card README · Tool：```js render_visual({ title: 'Title', html: '
...
', // height is optional; omit it and the card sizes itself to its content (recommended) **Height is automatic**: once the width is fixed, the card is as tall as its content — no fixed frame. When the content exceeds the configured cap, the card scrolls internally, so even a large card never forces you to scroll the whole conversation. Use theme variables instead of hard-coded colors:
dsh-visual-card README · Tool：`--v-bg-base`, `--v-bg-layer-1/2`, `--v-border`, `--v-text`, `--v-text-dim`, `--v-brand`, `--v-success/warn/error`

dsh-visual-card README · Settings：| Item | Effect |
|---|---|
| **Height cap** | Card height follows its content; above this share of the viewport (40–100%) the card scrolls internally instead of forcing a page scroll |
| **Allow scripts** | When off, buttons, animation and games do not run — only static content renders. Scripts run inside the host page, which is the only source of risk here |
| **Turns kept per conversation** | Older turns are dropped on write (10–2000) |
| **Max cards per turn** | Beyond this many in one turn only the newest are kept (1–50) |
| **Clear history** | Deletes `cards.json`, behind a second confirmation |
dsh-visual-card README · Settings：Changes save immediately to `~/.dsh/visual/settings.json`.

dsh-visual-card README · Storage：Cards are persisted per conversation and turn to `~/.dsh/visual/cards.json`, so they survive a restart. Retention is governed by the settings above.

Deleting the directory only loses visual history; functionality is unaffected.

dsh-visual-card README · Install：**The built-in plugin installer is the recommended way.** Open Settings → Built-in Plugins, paste the package name, press install, then restart the app:

```
dsh-visual-card
```

The installer writes the entry into `dsh.profile.bundles` for you; no manual file edits.

From the command line (quit the app completely first):

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm add dsh-visual-card
```

Add the package name to `dsh.profile.bundles` and restart the app.

dsh-visual-card README · Security：Scripts generated by the model **run inside the host page** — this is not a sandbox. That is the unavoidable cost of "clickable, can run games".

The plugin only enforces "no external resources" and performs no code review. Fine for personal use; if you point it at model output you do not trust, add a sandbox first.

dsh-visual-card README · Known limits：- Cards always render **below** the turn's answer and cannot be placed mid-text: the host supports a fixed set of 19 conversation node kinds, and a plugin cannot add one
- The `turnTail` slot only renders after the turn closes, so nothing appears while the answer is still streaming
dsh-visual-card README · dsh-visual-card： **中文** | [English](#english) 可视化回答插件：AI 交一段 HTML，在对话里渲染成一个**可交互的窗口**——能点、能用键盘操作、能全屏、能导出。

dsh-visual-card README · 效果：工具调用后，本轮回答下方出现一个窗口：

- 顶部工具条：标题 + 全屏 / 复制 / 下载
- 内容区是 AI 写的 HTML，脚本会真正执行（按钮、canvas、动画都能跑）
- 颜色自动跟随当前亮/暗主题

dsh-visual-card README · 能做什么：- 图表、色板、布局示意
- 可点击的演示（切换状态、翻页、展开细节）
- **完整的小游戏**（WASD 移动、canvas 逐帧动画）
- 需要键盘操作时，点进窗口才接管键盘，窗口外按键照常进输入框

dsh-visual-card README · 键盘规则：| 操作 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 点进窗口 | 窗口接管键盘，标题栏提示「键盘已交给窗口」 |
| 按 Esc | 释放键盘，回到输入框 |
| 点窗口外 | 自动释放 |
| 鼠标 | 始终正常（悬停、滚动、点击都不用先聚焦） |

实现上用了 iframe：AI 生成的脚本通常监听 `document` 的键盘事件，如果和宿主共用同一个文档，窗口外按键也会触发它。iframe 有独立的事件作用域，焦点不在里面就收不到键。

dsh-visual-card README · 设置：设置 → 可视化：

| 项 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| **高度上限** | 卡片高度按内容自动决定；超过这个比例（40–100% 视口高）就改成卡片内部滚动，不逼你滚动整个对话才能看全貌 |
| **允许执行脚本** | 关掉后按钮、动画、小游戏都不运行，只显示静态内容。脚本运行在宿主页面里，这是唯一的安全风险来源 |
| **每个会话保留轮数** | 超出的旧轮次在写入时丢弃（10–2000） |
| **每轮最多卡片数** | 一轮里超过这个数量只留最新的（1–50） |
| **清空历史** | 清掉 `cards.json`，带二次确认 |

改动即时保存到 `~/.dsh/visual/settings.json`。

dsh-visual-card README · 存储：卡片按「会话 + 轮次」落盘到 `~/.dsh/visual/cards.json`，重启后仍在。保留轮数与每轮上限由设置决定。

删掉这个目录只会丢失历史可视化，不影响功能。

dsh-visual-card README · 安装：**推荐：内置插件安装程序。** 打开「设置 → 内置插件」，粘贴包名，点安装，再重启应用：

```
dsh-visual-card
```

安装程序会自动写进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，不用手改任何文件。

命令行方式（先完全退出应用）：

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm add dsh-visual-card
```

然后把包名加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，重启应用。

dsh-visual-card README · 安全说明：AI 生成的脚本**运行在宿主页面里**，不是沙箱。这是「能点击、能跑小游戏」的必然代价。

插件只约束「不引用外部资源」，不做代码审查。自己用没问题；如果要在不信任 AI 输出的场景里用，请先自行加沙箱。

dsh-visual-card README · 已知限制：- 卡片固定渲染在本轮回答**下方**，不能插入正文中间——宿主的对话节点是固定 19 种，插件无法新增节点类型 - `turnTail` 槽位只在本轮结束后渲染，所以流式输出期间看不到卡片 --- **English** | [中文](#chinese) Visual answers for DeepSeek Harness: the model hands over a block of HTML and it renders as an **interactive window** inside the conversation — clickable, keyboard-operable, fullscreen-capable, exportable.

dsh-visual-card README · What it looks like：After the tool call, a window appears below the turn's answer:

- Toolbar: title plus Fullscreen / Copy / Download
- The content area is the model's HTML, and its scripts really run (buttons, canvas, animation all work)
- Colors follow the active light/dark theme automatically

dsh-visual-card README · What you can build：- Charts, color swatches, layout sketches
- Clickable demos (state toggles, paging, expanding detail)
- **Complete small games** (WASD movement, per-frame canvas animation)
- When a demo needs the keyboard, clicking into the window takes it over; keys outside keep going to the composer

dsh-visual-card README · Keyboard rules：| Action | Behavior |
|---|---|
| Click into the window | The window takes the keyboard; the title bar says so |
| Press Esc | Release the keyboard, back to the composer |
| Click outside | Released automatically |
| Mouse | Always works — hover, scroll and click need no focus first |

dsh-visual-card README · Keyboard rules：The implementation uses an iframe. Scripts generated by the model typically listen for `keydown` on `document`; if they shared the host document, keys pressed anywhere would reach them. An iframe has its own event scope, so it only receives keys while focus is inside.

dsh-visual-card README · Settings：| Item | Effect |
|---|---|
| **Height cap** | Card height follows its content; above this share of the viewport (40–100%) the card scrolls internally instead of forcing a page scroll |
| **Allow scripts** | When off, buttons, animation and games do not run — only static content renders. Scripts run inside the host page, which is the only source of risk here |
| **Turns kept per conversation** | Older turns are dropped on write (10–2000) |
| **Max cards per turn** | Beyond this many in one turn only the newest are kept (1–50) |
| **Clear history** | Deletes `cards.json`, behind a second confirmation |
dsh-visual-card README · Settings：Changes save immediately to `~/.dsh/visual/settings.json`.

dsh-visual-card README · Storage：Cards are persisted per conversation and turn to `~/.dsh/visual/cards.json`, so they survive a restart. Retention is governed by the settings above.

Deleting the directory only loses visual history; functionality is unaffected.

dsh-visual-card README · Install：**The built-in plugin installer is the recommended way.** Open Settings → Built-in Plugins, paste the package name, press install, then restart the app:

```
dsh-visual-card
```

The installer writes the entry into `dsh.profile.bundles` for you; no manual file edits.

From the command line (quit the app completely first):

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm add dsh-visual-card
```

Add the package name to `dsh.profile.bundles` and restart the app.

dsh-visual-card README · Security：Scripts generated by the model **run inside the host page** — this is not a sandbox. That is the unavoidable cost of "clickable, can run games".

The plugin only enforces "no external resources" and performs no code review. Fine for personal use; if you point it at model output you do not trust, add a sandbox first.

dsh-visual-card README · Known limits：- Cards always render **below** the turn's answer and cannot be placed mid-text: the host supports a fixed set of 19 conversation node kinds, and a plugin cannot add one
- The `turnTail` slot only renders after the turn closes, so nothing appears while the answer is still streaming
